# Tank Editor - Configuration

#### Site Tab

The Site tab contains the legal description and information about the location of the tank.

The following data fields are available on the Site tab:

- **City** - Indicates the city the tank is located in; up to 20 characters.
- **County** - The county the tank is located in; drop-down options are defined in the County Editor.
- **State** - The state the tank is located in; drop-down options are defined in the State Editor.
- **Country** - The country the tank is located in; drop-down options are defined in the Country Editor.
- **Time Zone** - The time zone of the tank location; drop-down options are defined in the Time Zone Editor.
- **Section** - The basic unit of a township and range; each section refers to an area of a square mile; up to three characters.
- **Quarter** - Each section is divided into quarter sections, which are each further divided into quarter sections, for a total of 16 parts per section; up to 25 characters.
  <div class="example">

  **For example:**

  "NW 1/4 of the SE 1/4" would refer to the most northwestern quarter of the southeastern quarter.

  

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 167;height: 166;" />

  </div>
- **Township** - A measure of the distance north or south from the baseline, six miles in length; up to four characters.
- **Range** - A measure of the distance east or west from the principal meridian, six miles in length; up to four characters.
- **Meridian** - A geographical north to south reference point; up to 25 characters.
- **Latitude** - A geographic coordinate specifying a north-south location on the Earth’s surface, measured from the Equator; up to 12 characters.
- **Longitude** - A geographic coordinate specifying an east-west location on the Earth’s surface, measured from the Prime Meridian; up to 12 characters.
- **Valid Products** - If enabled, valid products allow for the validation of the product on all incoming tickets or flow data from injection and withdrawal points. It also limits the products that a user may choose from when manually entering a ticket. By setting a product as the Default, when a ticket is manually entered on a tank, the ticket will be initialized to have this product.
